title: Google Programmable Search (web search)
description: Google's Custom Search JSON API as gohort's web search, declared as a service: the request and how its results are read are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Create a search engine at programmablesearchengine.google.com (its ID is the cx) and an API key for the Custom Search API at console.cloud.google.com. Choose it under Capabilities > Web Search and give the search engine ID (the cx) there; Test there makes one real search for a common phrase. No price is declared, as it depends on your plan: add a per_call cost to the connector's spec to see what searches cost. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; Web Search lists it by this name.

config.name: cx
config.label: Search engine ID (cx)
config.help: The ID of your programmable search engine, shown on its overview page.

config.name: api_key
config.label: Google API key
config.help: Kept with this connection, and sent only to the address it is given for.
